extra.reason: Fixed: BeadsLoop::new() no longer pre-spawns an idle, unprompted pi child. next() is now the single path that spawns+prompts a worker for the top ready bead, main.rs kicks it at startup and derives need_input from the loop, and every failure (bd error, spawn error, dead/refused pi) surfaces to the transcript and parks the loop. Covered by 9 tests using real fake pi/bd executables (src/testing.rs) plus a headless pty run.

ADR-0001 accepted and merged at docs/adr/0001-bash-terminal-state-pty.md. Decision: real PTY via portable-pty 0.9.0 (not piped bash -i). All 4 questions answered with spike evidence: (1) crate+version = portable-pty 0.9.0, dev-dep until looprs-553 promotes it; (2) raw passthrough to the real terminal while a command runs, no VT emulation, no markdown/re-wrap, transcript keeps escape-stripped copy, pty pinned to real terminal size; (3) Ctrl-C always forwarded to the shell (never quits looprs), Ctrl-Q quits in all modes, Ctrl-D EOF restarts the shell with a notice; (4) pi's RPC bash verified single-shot -- cwd/exports/bg jobs do NOT persist -- so Bash mode owns its subprocess. Spike: examples/spike_bash.rs + spikes/probes.sh, raw logs in spikes/results/ (Ctrl-C: 1.81s interrupted vs 6.01s ignored; interleaving lost in 9/10 contended pipe runs vs 10/10 preserved on pty; stty 30x100 -> 40x120 on resize; vim functional on pty, warns and unusable on pipes).

ADR-0002 (docs/adr/0002-session-abstraction.md) written and Accepted, with a compiling type skeleton in src/session/ (Session trait, SessionId{mode,generation}, SessionEvent/Msg envelope, SwitchAway policy, SessionConfig, Router owner with wrap+pump implemented, per-session SessionView) and stub impls whose every operation names its owning ticket. All 5 questions answered explicitly: (1) sync Session trait + spawn(mode,cfg,generation)->{Box<dyn Session>, UnboundedReceiver<SessionEvent>}, non-blocking because the router must never await a child; (2) Msg carries origin, built only via router::wrap; chunk not line; exactly one SessionDown per session; (3) Tab is a view change, never a kill - Bash/Pi warm, Beads drain-then-park; only Esc and shutdown kill; (4) Router actor owns the sessions, App only renders, one pump task per session, kill = shutdown+pump.abort; (5) per-session Transcript+Flusher paired in SessionView, seal-on-death, active view renders / owning view receives. cargo check + cargo test green (25 pass), no new warnings (25 vs 26 baseline). Contradicting tickets reconciled: looprs-05j acceptance rewritten, looprs-ctn/553/guh/ecr/afw corrected via appended notes.

Pi mode is a real chat now. src/session/pi_chat.rs: PiChatSession = handle + owning task, one persistent 'pi --mode rpc' child spawned on the first send and reused forever (set_active deliberately not overridden: a Tab never touches it). Spawn-once-reuse-forever proven by 'two_turns_share_one_child_and_the_second_remembers_the_first' (turn 2's answer quotes turn 1's text, pi_spawns()==1). Follow-up during a run goes in as 'steer', not a second 'prompt' (pi rejects a mid-run prompt), with one re-send as a fresh prompt if the steer raced the settle; input is never gated -- decision recorded as ADR-0002 amendment 2. Esc = clear_queue -> abort with the queued text handed back to the input box via the new SessionEvent::RestoreInput / Msg::RestoreInput (amendment 1), measured at <1s with a live held-open run; the restore never clobbers text typed since and never types into another mode's box. Child death is reported once by whichever path sees it first (stream end, or the failed send) as Exited{Crashed}, status goes Dead, and the next message cold-starts a replacement -- two tests cover both racing orders. Pi events still cannot move the beads machine ('a_pi_run_never_moves_the_beads_machine'), and pi's copies of the user's messages still never reach the transcript. 76 tests pass, rustfmt clean, no new warnings. Deliberately NOT here: the 'cancelling/cancelled' UI styling and the Beads+Bash Esc paths, which stay looprs-5g7; follow_up is unused in favor of steer. Protocol shapes were checked against the real pi binary (get_state/clear_queue/abort/steer, EOF-exit timing) rather than assumed.

Fixed in a3da638. Provenance now comes from the event and the transition lives inside BeadsSession: UiCommand::BeadsNext and Session::advance() are deleted (the UI can no longer ask for a bead), BeadsLoop::forward_records posts WorkerSettled{serial}/WorkerGone{serial} from the loop's own worker into the session's own mailbox, and BeadsTask::worker_settled answers it from the loop's step + parked + aborted flags. App::on_pi/apply_pi render only. All three acceptance criteria met: (a) app::tests::no_settle_ever_turns_into_a_command_from_the_app runs every box mode against a Pi, Beads and Bash settle and asserts the App emits zero UiCommands (stronger than 'no BeadsNext' -- the variant is gone); (b) session::beads::tests::the_loop_takes_its_next_pass_from_its_own_workers_settle proves the advance from a real agent_settled off a real pi child with no App, no UiCommand and no input mode present at all; (c) the grep check is a test now (the_ui_never_reads_the_input_mode_to_route_an_event), plus the_router_has_no_beads_advance_path_left. Added what the move required: per-pass worker serials (a late settle from a retired pass cannot bulldoze the live one), the aborted-settles-park rule from ADR-0002 Q3 (head start filed on looprs-5g7), and park-on-worker-death so a crashed worker can't leave the loop claiming WorkTickets with the input box hidden forever. 81 tests green (8 consecutive runs); ADR-0002 amended.

Async tokio::process calls; typed BdError{Unavailable,Failed,Malformed,Timeout} carrying exit code+stderr; claim/show/list/is_closed API; #[serde(other)] so a newer bd degrades instead of breaking; unit tests distinguish empty board vs bd failure vs malformed JSON vs missing binary.

Planner pass now diffs 'bd list --status open --limit 0' before/after the run; zero new tickets is an explicit error quoting the planner's own last message and parks in AwaitInput, N tickets are listed (id: title) before the first worker spawns, an unreadable board is its own 'unverifiable' verdict, and a planner that dies (or is 'handled') surfaces instead of hanging. commit 66ec2a8

Esc is wired end-to-end in all three modes with a shared contract (src/session/cancel.rs, ADR-0003): silent when idle, 'cancelling <thing>…' acknowledged before any round trip, 'cancelled' on unwind, and a loud named escalation if the child has not unwound within GRACE=3s. Beads kills the worker, parks, and names the bead left claimed; Pi kills the child (ExitReason::Cancelled, cold-start next message); Bash sends 0x03 and never kills the shell. A cancelled beads pass cannot read as agent_settled -> next bead. Decided: Esc never quits (double-Esc not adopted); Ctrl-C semantics unchanged. 186 unit tests pass; 19-check real-pty e2e (spikes/cancel_e2e.py) x3 runs all pass, each mode keystroke->cancelled in <1s.

cargo test green (208 tests, no network / no model / no real bd DB); all seven listed scenarios have named tests (index in docs/testing.md); fmt + clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (38 -> 0), gate wired as ./scripts/check.sh + Cargo.toml [lints.clippy] deny + tests/warning_gate.rs (--ignored) + CI looprs-gate.yml; blanket allow(dead_code) removed in favour of per-item justified allows; fake pi/bd moved to tests/fixtures/; beads decision layer forced pure (StepCause/PassGate/abort guards) with table tests.

Dynamic live-region height shipped as src/viewport.rs (policy + mechanics), wired into the frame loop in src/main.rs; the compile-time VIEWPORT_H is gone.

POLICY. desired_height(mode, term_rows, preview_rows, tool_rows) = chrome (status 1 + input 3) + the live text rows that actually want the screen, floored at chrome+1 (a frame that cannot show its input box is broken) and capped by MAX_LIVE_ROWS (40) plus a KEEP_SCROLLBACK_ROWS (3) margin so the live region reads as a pane inside a transcript instead of eating the window. Beads and Pi are prose and grow. Bash keeps a deliberately small fixed region - one live preview row - and it is documented in the module docs as the ticket requires: complete lines of shell output go straight to the scrollback as the transcript's own lines (ADR-0001 rule 1), so only the partial line the shell has not finished is live; a program that paints a screen takes the whole terminal via the `screen` passthrough (ADR-0001 Q2) and nothing of ours is drawn.

MECHANICS. ratatui 0.30 gives no setter for the viewport (Viewport::Inline(h) is read from a private field), so a new height means a new Terminal over a backend still looking at the same stdout. LiveView::fit parks the cursor on the live region's own top row, erases everything below it, and rebuilds. Growing scrolls by exactly the shortfall and lands the new viewport under the last line already written; shrinking cannot scroll at all, so flushed lines keep the rows they had. The erase is not tidiness: a fresh Terminal diffs against a blank back buffer, so a cell blank in the new frame but not on screen is last frame's text welded there for the session. Rows above the live region's top are never touched - asserted cell by cell against TestBackend.

FOUND WHILE MEASURING (kept, because it was on the acceptance path). Every cursor query an inline rebuild needs (ESC[6n) races the async key stream for the same stdin: if the stream is alive it eats the answer and the query waits out crossterm's 2s timeout. The frame loop therefore (1) stops the key stream across fit / resize_window, gated by needs_fit so a frame that changes nothing does not pay for a restart, (2) polls the real window size with an ioctl each frame - a SIGWINCH that lands while the stream is stopped is never delivered at all, and ratatui's own autoresize would otherwise resize mid-draw, i.e. query with the stream running - and (3) treats neither a failed shape change nor a failed frame as fatal: fit keeps the old height (needs_fit stays true, next frame retries from the same parked cursor) and a draw that failed did so in autoresize before swapping buffers, so there is nothing inconsistent to recover from.

TESTS. 19 new tests in src/viewport.rs (pure policy both ends of every clamp, plus TestBackend mechanics: grow, shrink, no-room grow, "never touches the rows above", streamed-session contiguity, zero-row terminal). 227 pass. ./scripts/check.sh clean: fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests.

REAL PTY. spikes/viewport_e2e.py (+ spikes/fake_pi_slow.py, which holds one assistant message open because the cargo fixture closes its reply before a frame can be drawn over it). 16/16 across 3 consecutive runs: a long streamed answer reaches 20+ rows, grows into them rather than starting full size, stays contiguous, and survives a 44x100 -> 30x80 resize taken mid-stream (first text repaint ~60ms, answer still on screen, stream keeps following, app alive to Ctrl-Q). Control run against the pre-ticket binary fails the row count (5 rows, as filed) and dies at the resize with the cursor-read timeout: spikes/results/viewport-e2e.log vs spikes/results/viewport-e2e-before-afw.log. Both spike runs are registered in spikes/README.md.
